verdict.summary: Neutralizing pytest-randomly shuffles test order per run flipped the outcome. The baseline passed 8 of 40 trials, a rate of 20%, while this branch passed 40 of 40, a rate of 100%; those totals include the confirmation trials, and the search phase alone tends to flatter the winner. The fresh confirmation batch is the unbiased read: 24 of 24 passed on this branch against 6 of 24 at baseline, with p = 1.841e-08 against an alpha of 0.05.
